steps.en: PLUS gets a success message after the paid notice is permanently suspended
steps.id: PLUS menerima pesan sukses setelah notice berbayar di-permanent-suspend

steps.en: The message carries the refund ID and time when a refund was made
steps.id: Pesan membawa ID dan waktu refund bila refund dibuat
steps.why_en: A related defect ticket on the refund ID is still open, and a failed refund is not flagged.
steps.why_id: Tiket cacat terkait ID refund masih terbuka, dan refund yang gagal tidak diberi tanda.

steps.en: The message states how the refund will be paid, such as card or PayNow
steps.id: Pesan menyebut cara refund dibayar, misalnya kartu atau PayNow
steps.why_en: The message has no refund mode; it can only be looked up separately as the original payment mode.
steps.why_id: Pesan tidak memuat cara refund; hanya bisa dicari terpisah sebagai cara bayar awal.
